name: Dino Dash
tagline: One course. Eight runners. Keep your feet moving.
description: Race little comet creatures along the same seeded course. Tap to jump over rocks and hold to duck under birds. The course speeds up as you run. Distance at a crash counts, and the most total metres after three rounds wins.
howToPlay: Your runner moves by itself. Tap JUMP to clear a rock.
Hold DUCK to slip under a bird. Release before the next rock.
A crash stops your distance for this round. Most total metres wins.
